marketLayer.title: US Tech & AI Infrastructure CapEx
marketLayer.fact: Major US cloud hyperscalers reported quarterly earnings highlighting resilient cloud service revenue and sustained increases in capital expenditure directed at AI hardware and data center expansion.
marketLayer.inference: Short-term margin compression risks are countered by strong structural order visibility for global semiconductor foundries and AI server supply chains.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Enterprise AI monetization velocity and potential power grid constraints delaying data center deployments.

marketLayer.title: HK Internet Platform & Digital Economy Rally
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index gained momentum during the HK session following regulatory signals reinforcing support for digital platform growth and consumer trade-in policies.
marketLayer.inference: Valuation multiples for major HK-listed e-commerce and consumer tech giants are seeing tactical re-ratings as domestic policy support stabilizes near-term revenue expectations.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Sustainability of domestic retail consumption recovery and ongoing macro spending caution.

marketLayer.title: US Federal Reserve Rate Cut Path & Macro Liquidity
marketLayer.fact: US Treasury yields experienced two-way volatility as mixed economic data shifted market probability pricing for upcoming Fed rate decisions.
marketLayer.inference: Capital flows are balancing between large-cap growth technology and rate-sensitive defensive equities, maintaining broad market dispersion.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Sticky core inflation metrics restricting the Fed's room for aggressive monetary easing.
